verdict.rationale: The evidence documents editor features (sliders, direct edits, layout controls) and collaboration (edit access, group chat), but nothing says any of it is available on a free tier without a paid seat. Community reports that users lost access to Claude Design projects after unsubscribing suggest access depends on a subscription. There is no affirmative evidence of a usable free plan.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat
